hotori.main: Crit Rate > Cosmos DMG % > Crit DMG > ATK %
hotori.subs: Crit DMG > Crit Rate > DMG % > ATK % > ATK

set.b4: Ignores 25% of enemies' DEF for 20s after the wearer casts Ultimate. Effect does not stack.

hotori.skills: Passive 1 > Ultimate > Passive 2 = Skill > Support = Basics

notes: An essential teammate for Hotori as recording MC's skill with Present Replay and replaying it during Time Stop will trigger another instant Esper Cycle, letting you get another reaction off right in the middle of Hotori's burst window which is a big deal.

As a Cosmos character, MC fits naturally into Blossom teams alongside Hotori, and her Blossom Enhancement ensures Vita Bud attacks keep going uninterrupted even during Time Stop, so you're not losing out on that damage.
Zero is also a good user of Speedy Hedgehog if you're looking to push more personal damage out of Hotori, since they don't need it as much themselves.
Chiz is a decent Sub DPS option in a dual DPS setup alongside Hotori, as she can deal solid damage outside of Hotori's burst windows and doesn't rely on being the sole focus of the team.

That said, the synergy isn't perfect. Hotori can't copy Chiz's enhanced Skill multiple times, and since Chiz's skill cooldown is already very low, the benefit of recording it with Present Replay is pretty limited compared to other teammates. It should be noted that when Present Replay is used, the skill is re-triggered using the Grain value at the moment Hotori triggers it, rather than the value at the time Chiz originally cast it.

Her Ultimate's Paranormal Ace stacks an additional ATK bonus on top of Hootie's buff, and since Hotori packs all her damage into Time Stop, having both buffs active going into her burst window is a big deal.
Her Signature Arc further boosts the active character's ATK while she's off-field.
A strong choice even when there's no opportunity to create an Esper Cycle, making her a reliable support option regardless of what team composition you're running Hotori in.
Provides healing to the team, and since Hotori can record and replay Edgar's skill during Present Replay, you can squeeze out some extra healing during her burst window which is a nice bonus.

As a Cosmos character, Edgar creates additional avenues for the Charge reaction, and his instant Charge refill can fully fill a teammate's Ultimate, though this unfortunately doesn't work with Hotori herself.

That said, MC will likely take the Cosmos slot over Edgar in most team compositions, as they offer more utility and damage, making it hard for Edgar to justify his spot outside of specific situations where healing is necessary.

A core member of Blossom teams alongside Hotori, as her passive Seize the Moment spawns additional Vita Buds and increases their limit on the field to 6, doubling the default limit and significantly boosting how much damage each Blossom proc can put out.

Works naturally as a Sub DPS alongside Hotori since her optimal playstyle is to switch in, use her skill to generate Rose Pact Bullets and Vita Buds, then switch out, which fits perfectly with Hotori's low field time nature.
A strong option for AoE content due to her ability to gather enemies easily with her skill, making Blossom procs hit more targets at once.

In the core Blossom team, Hotori can record and replay MC's skill during Time Stop to keep generating instant Esper Cycles, which means more Blossom procs and more chances for Jiuyuan's Vita Buds and Blossom Enhancement to do their thing. On top of that, replaying Jiuyuan's skill during Time Stop also grants her 4 additional Rose Pact Bullets, adding even more value to her rotation.

Likely the best dual DPS option to run alongside Hotori right now, as Nanally wants more uninterrupted field time than Hotori to get the most out of her burst windows, making them a great fit together. Nanally just deals a lot of damage especially in single target situations against bosses and is one of the best DPS in general right now.
